name: KingBreaker
source:
You play as a young man cast out as a murderer and a traitor for a crime you didn’t commit—against the only person you ever called family. Abandoned and left to rot, you now walk a path of blood and vengeance, hunting down the ones who destroyed your life.

Your journey will take you across a world caught between magic and machines—where ancient arcana collides with rising industry, and not everything is as it seems. Along the way, you’ll meet allies, lovers, and enemies. Some you'll trust. Some you'll regret ever knowing.

[From [url=https://mrvinegar.itch.io/kingbreaker]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个年轻人，因为你没有犯下的罪行而被当作杀人犯和叛徒而被驱逐——针对的是你唯一称之为家人的人。被遗弃并任其腐烂，你现在走上一条血腥和复仇之路，追捕那些毁掉你生活的人。

你的旅程将带你穿越一个夹在魔法和机器之间的世界——古老的奥秘与新兴的工业碰撞，但一切并不像看上去的那样。一路上，你会遇到盟友、爱人和敌人。有些你会信任。有些你会后悔知道了。

[来自[url=https://mrvinegar.itch.io/kingbreaker]Itch.io[/url]]
